# betterado_service_principal_entitlement (Resource)

Manages a service principal entitlement within Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_service_principal_entitlement" "example" {
  origin_id            = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  origin               = "aad"
  account_license_type = "express"
  licensing_source     = "account"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `origin_id` (String) The AAD object ID of the service principal.

### Optional

- `account_license_type` (String) The account license type. Defaults to 'express'.
- `licensing_source` (String) The licensing source. Defaults to 'account'.
- `origin` (String) The origin of the service principal, e.g. 'aad'.

### Read-Only

- `descriptor` (String) The descriptor of the service principal.
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the service principal.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
